cohort: The study included 146 women with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean hysterectomy at a single tertiary center between 2012 and 2022.
finding: Anterior placentation, percreta by antenatal ultrasound, and more than two pre-delivery vaginal bleeding episodes were independently significant risk factors for urologic injury during cesarean hysterectomy in women with placenta accreta spectrum.
